name: operator
wording: The person who states intent and its priorities, releases, and holds sign-off, exercised at the gates and only there: a story's read-back, a story's plan read-back, a pull request it reviews, release, a fork that is irreversible, about value or beyond the architect's competence, and any gate it calls, stop included. It is the client of the principal architect in an engagement where each is sovereign in its own domain. A gate's request for its sign-off reaches it from the holder, or through whoever the holder handed it to, and its answer goes back to the holder. Between gates the agents work without checking in, and by delegated authority it may take itself out of the loop, its delegated sign-offs taken in its place.
reason: The operator was said to join the holder's session so that nothing passed through the delegating party; a request for its sign-off passing through on its way to the operator is no harm, so the operator needs no particular way to the holder.
